artworks.title: Lady with Outstretched Arm, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.2 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows three full-body figures in an open formation. The figure on the left wears a coat, a hat with a feather, and has wavy hair falling to the shoulders. The middle figure wears a gown and a tall feathered headdress with curly hair extending down the back. The figure on the right wears a cloak-like garment and a hat with a feather, holding a cane. The background is a plain surface with text at the bottom in Latin.

artworks.title: Three Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures dressed in flowing garments and hats with feathers. The figures are sketched in a minimalistic style, standing in an evenly spaced row, each facing outward. Each figure's attire is elaborately detailed, suggesting movement through the dynamic folds of their robes and the angle of their hats. The drawing utilizes a monochrome palette, highlighting the fine, intricate line work that gives depth and texture to the clothing and hats. The background is left undetailed. Below the figures, there is an inscription in a decorative script that reads: "Cum Privile Reg. Israel excudit."

artworks.title: Lady with Large Plumes, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 8.1 cm (2 3/8 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: Three figures in traditional attire, each adorned with feathered hats, are depicted in distinct poses. The figures are placed apart, with the outer figures facing the center figure. The left figure is in a resting stance, the central figure stands with raised hands, and the right figure extends an arm forward. The clothing features intricate textures and patterns, lending an elegant and classic feel to the drawing. The background is simple, with text at the bottom that reads "Cum Privile Reg. Israel excudit."

artworks.title: Lady Seen from Behind, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.4 cm (2 1/2 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in period attire. The drawing features three figures occupying a space in the composition. The two figures on the sides are dressed in elaborate garments with wide-brimmed hats adorned with plumes, one holding a cane, while the other stands with his arms akimbo. The central figure is shown from the back. The style is reminiscent of detailed ink or pen sketches characteristic of early modern European artwork, with meticulous line work and attention to the textures of the fabrics. At the bottom, there is a printed inscription "Cum Privile Reg Israel excudit".

artworks.title: Lady with Outstretched Arm, Seen from Behind, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.4 cm (2 1/2 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures dancing with their backs to the viewer. They are dressed in elaborate historical clothing. The first figure wears a long coat and a hat with a curved brim. The middle figure wears a dress with a wide skirt and bodice, with an ornamented hairstyle. The third figure wears a coat, trousers, and a broad-brimmed hat. The figures have detailed linework emphasizing their fashionable attire. The background is plain and there is text at the bottom reading "Cum Privile Reg. Israel excudit."

artworks.title: Lady with Arms Folded, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.4 cm (2 1/2 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals lined up in the middle. The person on the left has their back to the viewer, holding a cane in their right hand. The middle figure faces right, hands clasped in front, wearing a long dress. The person on the right faces slightly right, holding a sword in their left hand. Each figure wears historical attire with feathered hats. The background is plain, with an inscription reading "Cum Privile Reg Israel exuudit" below. The image is monochrome, drawn with fine lines on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Lady with Wine Bottle, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.3 cm (2 7/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of three figures standing in a line. The drawing features three distinct characters sketched in fine detail on a plain background. The left figure is dressed in ornate attire, wearing a large hat with a feather and holding an oversized goblet. In the middle, there is a figure in a long dress holding a pitcher. On the right, the third figure stands with one hand on their hip and the other on the hilt of a sword tucked behind their back, also wearing a feathered hat. The figures are spaced symmetrically, and beneath them, there is some text written in an elegant script.

artworks.title: Lady in Long Cloak, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.3 cm (2 5/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three full-length figures arranged in a row. The person on the left is standing with their body slightly angled, draped in a long robe and wearing a hat with a tall feather. Their facial features appear simplified, likely due to the illustration style, and they have short to medium-length hair. The central figure faces forward, wearing a similar robe and a hat with plumes, with their long hair visible. The figure on the right is in profile with one leg extended, wearing a robe and a feathered hat matching the others. The background is plain and bordered at the bottom by an inscription reading “Cum Privilegio Reg. Israel excudit.”.

artworks.title: Lady with Plumes, and Two Gentlemen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.4 cm (2 1/2 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts three figures engaged in a dance or movement. The ink drawing shows three elegantly dressed figures in a sparse, undefined space. Each figure faces a different direction. The central figure faces forward with arms spread wide, while the flanking figures are turned slightly. Each figure wears a large hat with a feather, and historical attire with long coats and breeches. The hatched lines and minimal background focus on the figures, emphasizing their stances and attire. The phrase "Cum Privilegio Regni" is inscribed below the drawing.

artworks.title: Three Women, One Holding a Child
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.9 × 8.1 cm (2 5/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures of women standing in different poses. The first woman on the left leans on a walking stick, the woman in the center has her hands together in front, and the woman on the right holds something in her hands. They wear headscarves and long dresses. The background is a plain, textured surface with the signature "J. Callot in. f." visible at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: La belle jardinière
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18 × 12 cm (7 1/16 × 4 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains two seated figures on either side of a large banner. The figure on the left is a male with short hair and a laurel wreath, wearing a robe and holding a shallow bowl. The figure on the right is a female with long hair under a wide-brimmed hat, wearing a detailed dress and holding a basket of fruit. The background features lush foliage and an ornate banner, with a decorative vase and coat of arms at the top.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Varie Figure"
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 × 9.1 cm (3 7/16 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a market scene featuring print sellers and their customers. The drawing captures a bustling scene at a market stall adorned with a sign that reads "VARIE FIGVRE DI IACOPO CALLOT," with the word "fecit" indicating the artist's presence. A variety of individuals, all dressed in period attire with elaborate hats and cloaks, are gathered around a wooden stall displaying prints and artworks. The detailed linework emphasizes the textures of the fabric and the wood. Customers are shown interacting with the sellers, selecting prints from the table that displays several works. In the background, observers are seen peering with interest. There is a figure carrying a large roll on their back, possibly containing artistic works.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, in Profile, Facing Left
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 × 9.2 cm (3 5/16 × 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures holding baskets, depicted in profile with a scene of other figures and buildings in the background. The foreground of the image showcases two standing figures adorned in period attire, each holding a woven basket in their arms. Behind them, several smaller figures are engaged in conversation or activities, with some appearing to ride animals. To the left, part of a building with visible architectural details can be seen, providing a sense of place. The overall composition has a detailed ink drawing style.

artworks.title: Officer, Front View
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.6 × 8.6 cm (3 3/8 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full body depictions of the same person in slightly different poses. The person is standing with one hand on their hip and the other hand resting on the opposite side. They have facial features with a prominent nose and a focused expression. The person's hair is curly and voluminous, flowing from under a hat adorned with large feathers. They are wearing a long coat, a vest, trousers, knee-high boots, a sash crossing the chest, and a sword hanging at the hip. The background is plain and the artwork appears to be an etching.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman, in Profile, Facing Left
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.8 × 8.7 cm (3 7/16 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: Two women are depicted in full-body view, standing side by side and facing each other. Both women have delicate facial features with high cheekbones and soft expressions, and their hair is styled neatly beneath fabric head coverings. They are wearing long skirts, aprons, and loose-fitted long-sleeve tops, common attire for the depicted time period. The clothing has detailed folds, enhancing the fabric's texture. The women are standing with hands softly clasped in front of them. The background shows a minimalist landscape with sparse details, including figures carrying a load, walking with a stick, and a distant robed figure possibly playing a musical instrument.

artworks.title: Man in Cloak, Seen from Behind
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.8 × 9 cm (3 7/16 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals with their backs facing the viewer. They are wearing large, wide-brimmed hats with decorative elements and long cloaks that cover most of their clothing. One person has curly hair peeking out from under the hat. They appear to be standing or walking, with pointed-toe shoes visible. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, in Profile, Facing Right
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 9.5 cm (3 3/8 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays two full-body side profiles of women facing each other. Both women have their hair styled in a bun at the back of their heads and are wearing long, layered dresses with fitted bodices and peplums, featuring striped patterns on the skirts. Their footwear resembles flat shoes. The women are depicted against a minimal background that includes line drawings of trees and a rural setting with a few trees scattered around.

artworks.title: Officer, with Arm Extended, Front View
artworks.dimensions: plate (trimmed to plate mark): 8.8 × 8.5 cm (3 7/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays two full-body illustrations of men standing side by side. They are in a dynamic pose, standing upright with one arm raised and pointing upwards, and the other hand resting on their torso. Both have long hair tucked under hats adorned with feathers, large mustaches, expressive eyes, and are dressed in long coats with buttons, baggy trousers tucked into knee-high boots. The coats flare out slightly at the bottom. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Two Turks
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9 × 9.2 cm (3 9/16 × 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: Two figures stand side by side, wearing long garments and turbans with feathers on their heads. The figure on the left faces the viewer more directly, with a mustache and a slight smile, while the figure on the right is angled away. Other smaller figures in similar clothing are in the background. The setting is plain.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman, in Profile, Facing Right, with Arm Extended
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 9.3 cm (3 3/8 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body profiles of a person sketched in a side view. One arm is extended outward and the other rests on the hip. The person has a neutral expression, with a notable nose and styled hair covered by a cloth cap. They wear loose, layered clothing consisting of a tunic, gathered pants, and simple shoes. The background includes cows grazing, sparse trees, and grass.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket, Seen from Behind
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 8.7 cm (3 3/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing side by side, facing away from the viewer. Both women are holding large baskets on their heads with their arms, balanced on their hips. Their hair is styled up in curls with decorative elements. They are wearing long-sleeved, fitted tops with peplum detailing over long skirts. The skirts are gathered, adding volume to their attire. There are small figures in the background that appear to be people in conversation or movement. The scene is set against a plain, light-colored backdrop, with no additional background elements present.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Basket on Head, Front View
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 × 9.3 cm (3 5/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures standing upright. Each has one hand on their waist and the other hand holding a round basket on their head. They are dressed in long garments with coats and boots. Their hair is curly and visible beneath wide-brimmed head coverings topped with the basket. Both figures have calm facial expressions and hold baskets containing a jug. In the background, there are other figures, including one holding a tool and another bending over. The setting includes trees and a small building-like structure on the right. The scene is etched on a textured paper background with soft lines.

artworks.title: Officer with Large Plume, Front View
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.9 × 9.1 cm (3 1/2 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length illustrations of the same individual, depicted in standing positions. Both figures are facing slightly towards each other, with their arms raised; the left figure raises both hands, while the right lifts one. The character has curly hair and distinct facial features, including a wide smile. Each figure wears a large, elaborate hat adorned with a feather or decorative element. Their clothing consists of voluminous shirts with long sleeves, baggy pants, and shoes with long toes. Capes are draped over their shoulders, with one side of the cape seen gathered prominently in their hands. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Officer with Plume, Seen from Behind
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9 × 9 cm (3 9/16 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: Two male figures are depicted standing with their backs to the viewer, each with one arm extended outward. They wear distinctive hats with plumes, knee-length coats, and leggings. One figure's tunic features vertical stripes. A small plant is near the foot of one figure. In the background, smaller figures in period attire are present, one holding a staff and two others with spears or weapons. The background is minimal, emphasizing the figures in the illustration.
